how: One call per alias right after the run, the runner's environment: `claude -p --model <alias> --output-format json` with a one-word prompt. `model_usage` is the envelope's `modelUsage` keys. The CLI also makes side calls of its own on claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, so that key appears beside the alias's model on every route; `answered_by` is the other one.
